# AgentStack

> Public documentation for integrators and AI agents. Platform line 0.4.21. Public MCP catalog: 714 actions, 58 domains — verify live: GET /mcp/actions/summary.

The default loop is Work Graph, not the catalog: session → context.project_id → agents.work_next → packet.next_action → claim / execute → work_next. Recipe mcp_work_loop_v1. Prompt agentstack_closed_loop_autonomy. Live edits stay on the safe circle: connect → sandbox → review → promote.

- [Work Graph page](https://agentstack.tech/work-graph): The same story on the site

## Product surfaces

- [Plugins](https://github.com/agentstacktech/AgentStack/blob/master/docs/plugins/README.md): Cursor, Claude, GPT, Gemini, VS Code
